plainTranslation: Love that's serious, loyal, and built to last - and can run short on warmth. The Saturn person commits and stabilizes; the Venus person may feel loved but not adored, or kept at a measured distance. Failure mode: confusing endurance with affection, or letting love feel like an obligation. Show affection actively and don't ration it; durable and warm are different things, and you want both.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
